name: Spinal Schwannoma
definition: Usually benign nerve-sheath tumor arising from spinal roots, often intradural-extramedullary and capable of causing radiculopathy or cord compression.

investigations.principle: Contrast MRI is the key imaging study.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Surgery versus surveillance depends on symptoms, growth and neural compression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuralgia phenotype may be documented only in parallel with tumor diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Usually benign nerve-sheath tumor arising from spinal roots, often intradural-extramedullary and capable of causing radiculopathy or cord compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
